text:
sam: quick favor — spotted a perf regression in nightly for quant combo int4+fp8 on convo-heavy traces. latency up and throughput down vs stable-2025-11. can someone run a focused benchmark + kernel profile?

maya: yeah i can take a pass. can you paste the exact repro command and the workload (prompts + batch sizes)? also which model shard/variant are we comparing? :eyes:

sam: repro + data below. comparing `stable-2025-11` -> `main-quant-optim` run. workload is our conv prompt set (conv_small/common_prompts.json), seeds fixed. command:```bash
python infra/bench/run_bench.py \n  --model redwood/13b-compat \n  --quant int4:fp8 \n  --variant main-quant-optim \n  --compare-to stable-2025-11 \n  --prompts data/conv_small/common_prompts.json \n  --batch-sizes 1,4 \n  --tokens 512 \n  --seed 42 \n  --profile-kernel \n  --output /tmp/quant-regress.json
```
small log from the failing nightly:```
[2026-03-16T23:12:01Z] model init ok
[2026-03-16T23:12:06Z] warmup complete
[2026-03-16T23:12:11Z] avg latency token=1 -> 138.4ms (baseline 125.1ms)
[2026-03-16T23:12:19Z] throughput batch=4 -> 620 tps (baseline 680 tps)
```

jun: i can run this in my queue. will need ~2h for full profile and kernel traces. which gpu pool should i use (dev, perf or staging)?

rick: fwiw i pushed a small kernel micro-optim last week (PR #2423) that touched attention tiling when fp8 path active — could be related. added a quick perf snapshot to dashboards: https://perf.redwood/company/quant/183000 — shows latency +11% on short seqs, throughput -8% at b=4. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maya: thanks @rick — can you drop the diff or PR link here? i want to grep for tiling changes vs stable.

rick: sure — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2423 diff touches `kernels/attn_tile.cu` around the `pack_qkv` path. small memcopy reorder.

ci-bot: nightly-quant-main-2026-03-16 completed — artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/nightly-quant-main-183000-2026-03-16.tar.gz. perf-report attached: /artifacts/perf_report_183000.html

maya: plan: i'll run sam's bench with `--profile-kernel` + `--nvprof` on perf pool, capture flamegraphs and kernel timelines. i'll also run stable-2025-11 on same hardware to rule out infra drift. tagging @jun for queue access.

jun: got queue access to perf pool. starting run now, will post outputs when done. if we see the regression on identical HW then it's likely code change (PR 2423 candidate). if not, could be driver/cuda or packaging.

sam: thanks. also can we include a small quality check: BLEU-ish style similarity on the conv prompts (we saw an edge-case hallucination in one prompt) — include `script/eval_similarity.py --ref=gold.json --cand=out.json` in the run. want both perf and quality numbers.

maya: will add the quality eval. also please note to pin `CUDA=12.2` in the bench run, since perf pool has mixed drivers.

jun: first pass results (batch=1, 1-token): main-quant-optim latency median 140ms, stable 124ms. profiling shows heavy stall in `attn_tile_kernel` (kernel time +22%). attaching short flame snippet:```
attn_tile_kernel  ->  22.1ms (main) | 18.1ms (stable)
other_kernels    ->  11.3ms (main) | 10.9ms (stable)
```

rick: matches my suspicion. PR2423 memcopy reorder likely causing less contiguous loads for the fp8 path. can we try a revert patch to validate?

maya: i'll draft a quick revert/alternative that restores previous packing order but keeps other optimizations. will run A/B on perf pool.

sam: appreciate it. if reverting fixes perf but breaks some edge-case numerics we need to tradeoff — prefer perf for our 95p latency SLOs, but must not regress quality.

jun: note: int4 path seems slightly more sensitive to packing order than fp8; the combo int4:fp8 has mixed code paths. need to test int4-only and fp8-only to isolate.

maya: running int4-only / fp8-only now. will post microbench in ~45m.

ci-bot: perf job `quant-quick-183000-01` completed. artifact: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/quant-quick-183000-01.tar.gz

maya: quick summary: int4-only ~no regression vs stable (latency ~126ms). fp8-only shows the +12% latency. combo int4+fp8 matches fp8-only behavior. suggests fp8 kernel change is primary culprit. flamegraphs attached in artifact.

rick: ok that's narrower. i'll open PR with a patch that reorders the copy only for fp8 path and keeps the new order for other paths — quick test locally looked promising. PR #2471.

sam: can we run PR2471 on perf and run quality evals? if perf recovers and quality stays equal -> merge.

jun: queued PR2471 run. will include eval_similarity check.

maya: PR2471 run results: latency back down to baseline (125ms), throughput b=4 up to 678 tps. quality eval shows no meaningful change (delta similarity < 0.2%).

sam: awesome. can we promote to canary tomorrow, and include rollback plan if anomalies show? also add a short note in the release checklist about fp8 packing sensitivity.

rick: will open canary rollout ticket and add test to our quant regression suite to run fp8-only microbench nightly.

maya: i'll own canary watch and overall triage for 24h. adding smoke checks: 1-token latency, batch4 throughput, and eval_similarity on conv_small.

sam: thanks everyone. closing the loop — assigning ownership to maya for 24h. :tada:
